topic: Tracking problematic sensor data and changes
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on two main points: identifying malfunctioning sensors at an airport facility (PMG_ZA_ORT) and establishing a process for tracking sensor changes.

Regarding the faulty sensors, [p4] noted that two specific sensors were showing poor correlation data within a large network of otherwise functioning sensors. The MAC addresses and associated facility names were provided for review. Later, [p4] requested assistance in determining the location of another problematic sensor (PMG_ZA_KMIA_Domestic_Departure lounge) based on its coordinates due to observations suggesting it was placed in an infrequently trafficked area.

To manage ongoing changes and potential data loss related to these sensors, [p12] suggested creating a dedicated file or tracking system. Initially, [p4] proposed using a separate board in Jira for individual sensor tickets; however, the conversation concluded with an agreement on a new process.
decisions: A formal method is needed to track changes and data related to problematic sensors.
action_items: Follow up on the location/status of the specified faulty sensors.
